character.name: Runebound A spellblade in deep navy blue robes with glowing cyan rune markings on the chest — a glowing star or sigil symbol at the center. Carries a tall runesword with a glowing cyan orb at the top of the hilt that pulses with light. A small glowing gem or crystal floats above the head. Medium build, somewhere between a mage and a warrior. Palette is dark blue, royal blue, and electric cyan.
